scope: Implemented bounded multi-reference native-text benchmark. Sequential persistent-model requests with reset/reprepare of one session; not a continuous batching/serving scheduler.

interface.order: Positional reference is index0; extra flags append. Total runs rotate round-robin; both skip-special modes exercised for each input by toggling per complete cycle.
interface.geometry: Read each source frame geometry before GPU model setup; prepare maximum batch/context once; each request retains own prefill geometry, immutable source docs, encoder/decoder/scratch/tokens/output buffers. Session reset and preparation stay outside timer.
interface.output: Multi-reference JSON adds request_index and request_count. Existing single-reference output/skip schedule and CLI behavior preserved; checked with numerical and normal/ASAN timing controls.

implementation.synthetic_tests: test/test_native_text_workload.c: bounded cycle selection, balanced skip modes for1..8 inputs, real short/long geometries, invalid dimensions/overflow/empty plan and unchanged outputs on rejection
implementation.latency: Recorder callbacks remain unchanged: clocks/input IDs/output bytes only, no file IO/full-logit copies/additional GPU work. Request labels print after timer. Independent reference comparisons occur after timer.

qualification.scope: Bounded multi-reference benchmark, source-exact variable-length session reset, default/committed/prediction/ASAN/eight inputs/GPU checks; no serving concurrency claim

correctness.gpu_checks: memcheck:AB/1024 entries; initcheck:BA/2048 entries; four source-exact requests each, zero errors. Reverse order starts shorter request with larger workspace. No racecheck claim.
correctness.sanitizer_scope: New benchmark/helper code instrumented with Clang18 ASAN/UBSAN; existing instrumented generation/tokenizer/JSON/bridge/host-cache objects retained. Other unchanged runtime/GPU objects normal; GPU accesses checked separately. Eight codec/reference owners and repeated smaller/larger requests pass source and cleanup controls.
correctness.scope: Each request compares all actual encoded/forward IDs, every published last F32 vocabulary word, generated IDs/UTF8 chunks/order/position to its original source; legacy native control and single512/short/long committed/prediction modes preserved.

resolved_audit_issue: Initial artifact parser missed a multiline NVCC command for rebuilt gpu_cuda_fa2.o. Freeze failed before qualification; continuation-aware parser corrected, failed log/script archived. Only actual compiler outputs repinned; no numerical/source oracle changes.
limits: One sequential reused session and persistent model, two related source prompts, five generated tokens each; no concurrent sessions, network serving or continuous batching claim.
Six later samples per request type/quota across AB/BA starts; first encounter of each prompt reported separately. Clocks/NUMA/OS filecache uncontrolled, managed-cache-empty not disk-cold.
GPU quota1024 fitted the prior fixed replay but not this1427-entry union; do not infer universal cache sizing or production hit rates. Longer decoding and wider prompt diversity still needed.
RAM admission used190.5GiB payload quota; actual RSS is separate. Device admission includes headroom but full4096 physical occupancy is unproven.
Counters report GPU misses/hits/upload bytes; explicit eviction counts are not emitted by this timing path. Upload timer is host callback time, not isolated DMA or exposed stalls.
Explicit Diffbot INT4 BF16 lookup to Exllama F16 Engram source adapter, not original Diffbot full-runtime equivalence. No fully resident matched vLLM parity or broader CPU/Metal completion claim.
No runtime defaults changed; full modern-model performance/placement/serving objective remains active and incomplete.
